sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.Virtual = 'F'
AND satscores.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.Virtual = 'F'
AND satscores.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.Virtual = 'F'
AND satscores.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS VirtualSchoolCount
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'Yes';

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode) 
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'Yes';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 1;

SELECT COUNT(schools.CDSCode)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.Virtual = 'Yes'
GROUP BY schools.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(schools.CDSCode)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.Virtual = 'Yes'
GROUP BY schools.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.Virtual = 'F'
AND satscores.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY schools.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'F'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM satscores
    WHERE satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
    GROUP BY satscores.cds
    HAVING AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) > 400
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'Yes'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'Yes'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'Yes'
GROUP BY s.NCESSchool
HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'Yes';
